item.title: FDA Relaxes Rules on ‘No Artificial Colors’ Claims
item.description: Companies will now have flexibility to claim products contain no artificial colors when products do not contain petroleum-based colors.

item.title: New FARE Campaign Features Food Allergy Parent Tia Mowry
item.description: Food Allergy Research & Education, a charity that supports those impacted by food allergy, announced the release of a new public service announcement, titled “Ready to Live.”

item.title: Eco-Products to Launch Environmentally Responsible Packaging in the UK
item.description: The company is launching the Eco-Products portfolio of reusable, recyclable and compostable packaging in the U.K., with products available through U.K.-based Vegware, a sister company.

item.title: Violet Foods Acquires Muir Glen Brand
item.description: The company announced it acquired the Muir Glen Brand of organic tomato products from General Mills.

item.title: GrubMarket Raises $50 Million for eCommerce and AI Transformation
item.description: This significantly up round values GrubMarket at a pre-money valuation of $4.5 billion.

item.title: Boar's Head Reopens Virginia Facility Linked to 2024 Listeria Outbreak
item.description: The Jarratt plant has been closed since July 2024, when a multistate Listeria outbreak linked to liverwurst produced at the facility sickened 61 and killed 10.

item.title: Eagle Product Inspection Highlights Pack 430 PRO
item.description: The Pack 430 PRO X-ray inspection system with PXT is designed to deliver clear, consistent imaging across layered, dense and compartmentalized trays while maintaining stable performance at high throughput rates, according to Eagle Product Inspection.

item.title: NASDA Sets Federal Policy Focus for 2026
item.description: The National Association of State Departments of Agriculture's primary policy focus for 2026 includes agricultural labor reform, animal disease preparedness and traceability, the Farm Bill, pesticide regulations, and regional food procurement and distribution.

item.title: IAFP 2026 Registration Now Open
item.description: The International Association for Food Protection will hold IAFP 2026, the association’s annual meeting, July 26-29, in New Orleans, La.

item.title: FDA Launches Reassessment of Food Preservative BHA
item.description: The agency is reviewing whether butylated hydroxyanisole, a chemical preservative used to prevent spoilage of fats and oils in food, is safe based on the latest scientific information.
